S1_IGNITION.name: Momentum ignition
S1_IGNITION.description: relVol≥2 + range expansion + close at day extreme → next-day continuation

S2_CHEAPIV.name: Cheap-IV breakout
S2_CHEAPIV.description: RV20 rank ≤30 + 20d high/low breakout → next-day continuation

S3_FRIDAYPIN.name: Friday pin-break
S3_FRIDAYPIN.description: Friday compressed first 30m, break after 10:00 → extension to close

S4_TENAM.name: 10:00 conditional
S4_TENAM.description: strong first 30m, continuation break by 10:30 → extension to close

methodology.intraday_window: 1 month of 5-minute bars, liquid large-caps (S3, S4) — Yahoo rejects 1m/1mo (HTTP 422)
methodology.option_model: Black-Scholes; entry IV = trailing 20d realized vol floored at 15%; 1% OTM 1DTE (S1/S2), 0.5% OTM 0DTE (S3/S4); exit at intrinsic on close; 5% friction haircut

caveats: No free source publishes historical intraday option chains — ticket P&L is MODELED, not observed fills.
IV proxied by trailing realized vol; actual 0DTE IV skew/smile and bid-ask spreads will differ.
S3/S4 sample is one month of Fridays — small-n; treat as preliminary until more Fridays accumulate.
Survivorship: universe is current S&P 500 constituents.
